sn45.11:1.3: namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenāti || ||
sn45.11:1.4: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paṭissutvā nāssudha koci Bhagavantam upasaṅkamati aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena || || 3.
sn45.11:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn45.11:2.2: Yena svāham bhikkhave vihārena paṭhamābhisambuddho viharāmi || tassa padesena vihāsiṃ || || 4.
sn45.11:2.11: Chando ca avūpasanto hoti || vitakko ca avūpasanto hoti || saññā ca avūpasantā hoti || tappaccayā vedayitaṃ || || [Chando ca vūpasanto hoti || vitakkā ca avūpasantā honti saññā ca avūpasantā honti || tappaccayā pi vedayitaṃ || || Chando ca vūpasanto hoti || vitakkā ca vūpasantā honti || saññā ca avūpasantā honti || ||]
sn45.11:2.12: Chando ca vūpasanto hoti || vitakko ca vūpasanto hoti || saññā ca vūpasantā hoti || tappaccayā vedayitaṃ || || 6.
sn45.11:2.13: Appattassa pattiyā atthi āyāmaṃ || || tasmim pi ṭhāne anuppatte tappaccayā pi vedayitan ti || || 1.2.
